children: will recall 810,592 vehicles in the United States to replace Takata airbag inflators that could potentially experience propellant degradation, the automaker said on Friday
The recall covers certain 2012-2013 Honda Civic and CR-V models, 2013 Honda Accord, 2013 Acura ILX, and 2013 Acura RDX vehicles originally sold or registered in 14 US states and territories.
The affected vehicles are equipped with front driver and/or passenger airbag inflators containing a moisture-absorbing desiccant. Honda
said long-term monitoring and analysis revealed potential propellant degradation in certain inflators in regions with high temperatures, humidity, and significant temperature fluctuations.
The company said no inflator ruptures, injuries, or fatalities have been reported in connection with the newly recalled inflator types.
will replace the affected inflators free of charge. Mailed notifications to vehicle owners are scheduled to begin in December 2026.
Owners can check their vehicle's recall status through Honda and Acura's recall websites or by calling the company's dedicated recall helpline, Honda

title: Honda recalls 810,592 US vehicles over Takata airbag inflators
